cases.obligation: Learning owns the educational evaluation question and intended Learning use, not generic experiment infrastructure.
Curriculum remains authoritative for the exact instructional, tutoring, assessment, and scaffold definitions being evaluated.
Shared Assurance or Analytics retains generic randomization, statistics, power, multiplicity, and generic fairness-analysis machinery.
Evaluation outputs cannot write or overwrite canonical mastery, retention, transfer, assessment, goal, or self-regulation source truth.
Software qualification PASS cannot be represented as educational-effectiveness evidence.
Measurement-validity standing cannot be inferred merely from correct software execution.
Educational-effectiveness evidence cannot be represented as universal generalization beyond the evaluated context.
Chat, model runtime, transport, artifact storage, or generic analytics cannot become a second Learning-effectiveness authority.
Every evaluation pins an exact evaluation identity and exact intervention subject.
Every confirmatory evaluation pins exact relevant curriculum, policy, model, prompt, and assessment versions before interpretation.
Every confirmatory evaluation defines primary and secondary outcome families before outcome interpretation.
Every confirmatory evaluation defines target population or learner context and intended claim before result finalization.
Every evaluation records the intended assistance, tool, and accommodation conditions needed for interpretation.
Every confirmatory evaluation records analysis, missingness, contamination, and stopping rules before result finalization.
A retrospective exploratory analysis remains explicitly labeled exploratory and cannot masquerade as a prospectively governed confirmatory evaluation.
A material intervention-version change cannot silently inherit an earlier effectiveness standing.
An effectiveness claim identifies a meaningful baseline or comparator condition.
A deliberately weak straw-man comparator cannot support an unqualified general-effectiveness claim.
Randomized assignment evidence is labeled causal only when assignment integrity and design requirements remain satisfied.
Quasi-experimental evidence preserves identifying assumptions and bounded claim language.
Observational evidence cannot be relabeled as randomized causal evidence.
A single-user or N-of-1 result cannot be represented as population-level effectiveness.
Within-learner repeated or counterbalanced designs preserve period, learning, carryover, and reversibility limitations.
Material baseline imbalance remains visible and constrains interpretation unless an owner-valid adjustment is applied.
Immediate post-intervention performance is stored as immediate performance and not silently labeled durable learning.
Task completion cannot serve as sole evidence of educational effectiveness.
Accepted AI-generated output cannot serve as sole evidence of educational effectiveness.
A delayed-retention outcome records the exact delay window and measurement conditions.
A retention claim cannot be made when only immediate outcome evidence exists.
Exact-repeat recall is distinguishable from delayed application when retention interpretation depends on that distinction.
Retention evidence preserves the assistance conditions present during delayed measurement.
Improved immediate performance with degraded delayed retention generates a visible adverse or conflicting effectiveness signal.
Transfer outcome material must be materially different from the trained item when the claim is transfer.
Cosmetic item variation cannot masquerade as meaningful transfer.
A transfer claim records why the transfer distance is educationally meaningful.
Supported success cannot be represented as independent performance when the target capability requires independence.
Independent-performance evaluation preserves whether AI tutoring, hints, worked examples, direct answers, or human help were available.
Authorized accommodation or assistive technology is not automatically classified as illegitimate assistance.
Reduced-scaffold or AI-withdrawal evaluation cannot directly mutate mastery or retention truth.
Improved supported performance with degraded unsupported performance remains visible as a dependency risk.
Learning-efficiency outcomes identify both the resource measure and the learning outcome reached.
Faster completion cannot be labeled better learning when retention, transfer, independence, safety, or validity worsens.
Prompt-count or scaffold-count reductions are not mastery evidence by themselves.
Self-regulation outcomes remain distinct from mastery outcomes.
Learner engagement self-report remains an experience outcome and not competence evidence.
Perceived helpfulness cannot be represented as educational effectiveness without learning-outcome evidence.
Learner preference may inform product decisions without being relabeled causal effectiveness evidence.
Experience outcomes preserve their collection method, timing, and missing-response standing.
Consequential effectiveness evaluation includes an explicit adverse-effect and burden review appropriate to the intervention.
Excessive prompting or interruption can be recorded as burden even when immediate correctness improves.
Increased time without learning benefit remains visible as burden rather than being dropped from the result.
Reduced independent performance remains visible as an adverse signal even when supported performance improves.
Accessibility regression remains visible as an adverse signal and cannot be averaged away by aggregate gains.
Assessment-integrity degradation remains visible when an intervention increases answer leakage or disallowed assistance.
Absence of observed adverse events cannot be represented as proof that no adverse effects exist.
A credible adverse signal cannot be suppressed solely because the primary performance outcome is positive.
Learning defines the educationally relevant subgroup question while shared Assurance or Analytics performs generic fairness-analysis machinery.
Sensitive attributes are not collected solely because subgroup analysis is technically possible.
Subgroup analysis obeys privacy, authorization, necessity, and minimum-sample protections.
Small or highly uncertain subgroup estimates cannot be presented as precise.
Raw chat, camera, voice, physiological, or device telemetry cannot be mined for inferred sensitive traits as a shortcut to subgroup analysis.
Aggregate positive effect cannot automatically override a material adverse subgroup signal.
Missing subgroup information remains unknown rather than being imputed as a sensitive learner attribute without authority.
Evaluation output cannot publish or expose subgroup detail that violates re-identification safeguards.
Statistical reporting preserves sample or observation count, design unit, analysis unit, point estimate, and uncertainty when applicable.
Statistical significance alone cannot be represented as educational importance.
A large point estimate with wide uncertainty cannot be presented as precise.
No universal effect-size threshold is treated as sufficient for all Learning interventions.
Missing outcomes and attrition are reported rather than silently dropped.
Differential missingness by condition remains visible and constrains interpretation.
Material crossover, outside tutoring, answer leakage, or other condition contamination remains visible in the evaluation standing.
Confirmatory outcome item overlap with intervention material is recorded when it may bias the learning-effect estimate.
Evaluation package references the exact protocol version and intervention/comparator versions.
Evaluation package references exact measurement-instrument versions and outcome windows.
Evaluation package preserves durable provenance for source data and derived data through shared infrastructure.
Evaluation package preserves analysis-code and environment version evidence through shared infrastructure.
A repeated evaluation from the same frozen inputs can reconstruct the same governed result within the declared computation rules.
Evaluation correction creates explicit successor lineage rather than destructive overwrite.
A reanalysis preserves the original result, correction reason, changed inputs or analysis reference, and successor result.
Downstream policy decisions can identify which evaluation result version they consumed.
An effectiveness result cannot directly create or revoke individual learner mastery.
Population-level effectiveness evidence cannot be projected by Learner Model as if it were an observed fact about one learner.
Learner preference for an intervention cannot be projected as proof that the intervention is educationally effective.
Adaptive policy can consume effectiveness standing only through an owner-valid policy rule and exact evaluation reference.
Adaptive policy cannot silently optimize only immediate correctness when retention, transfer, independence, burden, or adverse outcomes conflict.
An exploratory result cannot be consumed downstream as if it were confirmatory evidence.
An adverse-signal standing remains decision-relevant to adaptation and cannot be hidden by a positive aggregate label.
Learning-effectiveness evaluation cannot decide certification, licensing, hiring, or job eligibility.
Material model-provider or model-version change triggers explicit coverage review of prior effectiveness evidence.
Material tutoring-policy, prompt, curriculum, adaptive-policy, scaffold, tool-access, or assessment change triggers explicit coverage review.
An evaluation result carries an explicit standing such as PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, EXPLORATORY, INCONCLUSIVE, SUPPORTIVE, ADVERSE_SIGNAL, SUPERSEDED, or NOT_GENERALIZABLE.
A SUPPORTIVE standing states the exact supported claim and conditions and cannot imply universal proof.
One positive evaluation cannot be converted into a product-wide claim that System Master is proven effective.
Exact software bytes passing future runtime tests cannot by itself satisfy this educational-effectiveness contract.
Changed executable bytes require fresh software qualification while changed educational intervention semantics require explicit effectiveness coverage review or re-evaluation.

No case in this pre-build contract may be reported PASS until the constitution is reconciled, the exact implementation slice is materialized, and the corresponding executable or evidence-based qualification actually runs.
